"""Use installed rig builder with verified ObjectIds, bypass QRT name resolution."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pycsc
from prototypes.rigs.qrt.biped import Biped,BipedData,BipedSettings
from prototypes.qrt_prototypes.create import _process_qrt
root=Path('C:/Users/hp/Downloads/alpine-apex/artifacts/cascadeur_rig_20260910_r4')
assert Path(app.current_scene().get_path_name()).parent==root
scene=app.current_scene().domain_scene()
mv=scene.model_viewer()
ids={mv.get_object_name(o):o for o in mv.get_objects() if mv.get_object_type_name(o)=='Joint'}
template=json.loads((root/'apex_joint_paths.qrigcasc').read_text())
mapping={n['Bone name']:n['Joint name'] for d in template['Document'] for s in d['Sections'] for n in s['Names']}
settings=BipedSettings(create_layers=True,replace_existing=True,align_pelvis=True,spline_ik=True)
data=BipedData(settings,node_joints={field:ids[name] for field,name in mapping.items()})
py_scene=pycsc.wrap(scene)
Biped.add_qrt_json(py_scene,json.dumps(template))
builder=Biped(json.dumps(template),py_scene,data,10.,10.,np.array([.2,.7,1.],dtype=np.float32))
builder.run_rig_process(_process_qrt)
bv=scene.behaviour_viewer()
actual={mv.get_object_name(bv.get_behaviour_owner(bv.get_behaviour_reference(b,'joint'))) for b in bv.get_behaviours('TechnicalLinks')}
print('explicit generated joints',sorted(actual))
assert set(mapping.values())==actual,('Generated joint set differs',actual)
print('explicit generated assignment', {str(n):builder.get_joint(n).name for n in data.node_joints})
